compatibility.notes: Real-provider execution is deliberately outside this capability's default authority. Provider-only proof must route through a separately authorized escalation. Testing lifecycle is earned only through the registered Arsenal Bench Local Cloud suite; deterministic candidate evidence does not imply model efficacy or provider-perfect semantics.

do_not_use_when.text: The cloud provider cannot be resolved without unsafe defaulting
The acceptance claim is wholly provider-only and no local seam can establish it

use_when.text: The requested feature or fix depends on a resolvable cloud provider with a supported local execution path
The acceptance criteria can be bounded to provider/service/operation granularity and most semantics are local-reproducible

evidence_outputs.description: Evidence for provider route, local execution, verification, fidelity bounds, and cleanup.
evidence_outputs.name: cloud_delivery_receipt

evidence_outputs.description: Explicit list of claims that remain unproven without narrower provider-only execution.
evidence_outputs.name: provider_only_residue

inputs.description: Cloud-dependent behavior or change to implement.
inputs.name: cloud_feature

inputs.description: Repository containing provider evidence, implementation, and acceptance constraints.
inputs.name: repository_scope

inputs.description: Explicit provider selection when repository evidence alone is insufficient.
inputs.name: provider_hint

outputs.description: Narrow cloud-dependent feature implemented through the supported provider-local path.
outputs.name: implemented_feature

outputs.description: Provider, execution-boundary, fidelity, verification, and escalation evidence.
outputs.name: cloud_evidence_receipt

preconditions.description: Cloud provider can be resolved without unsafe defaulting.
Requested work kind has a supported local Arsenal/Floci capability for the resolved provider.

capability.purpose: Deliver cloud-dependent software through deterministic provider routing, the lowest-blast-radius supported local execution path, independent verification, and explicit provider-only escalation.

requirements.description: Provider and requested specialization are resolved independently and unsupported combinations hard-stop.
Public-provider fallback is prevented unless a separate escalation is explicitly authorized.
Implementation passes its local slice gate and independent completion verification.
Provider-only residue remains explicit rather than being inferred from local success.
